input.quote: Customer owes Fees only for conforming Services provided through the effective termination date, and Vendor shall promptly refund prepaid Fees allocable to the period after that date.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, or minimum fee payable by Customer, so it meets the preferred position. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "termination fee", "shortfall", and acceleration language returned no Customer-payable stipulated sum: § 9.4 lets Customer terminate for convenience owing Fees only for conforming Services rendered (with refund of prepaid Fees), § 27.3 permits force-majeure termination "without penalty", and § 24.4 bars Fee acceleration on Customer change of control. The § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment (USD 2,000,000 per year with no reduction or termination rights) is a minimum purchase commitment rather than a stipulated damages amount and is addressed under the minimum-commitment rule, so it is not flagged twice here.
